proposed.text: Which of the following areas is included in GFA under the Guidelines on Determining GFA?

options.text: Rooftop ACCU platforms and water tanks, which are typically excluded from GFA calculations due to their mechanical nature
Balconies with a floor area of 10.0 sqm or less per unit
Elevator shafts and stairwells in parking floors (counted once), as they are considered part of the building's core services
Uncovered swimming pools and court areas, generally excluded unless specified otherwise in local amendments
